chunks.ar: كان ثعلب يعيش في كهف على جبل، ويعاني الجوع كثيرًا.
chunks.en_old: A hungry fox lived in a cave on a mountain.
chunks.en_new: A fox lived in a cave on a mountain and often suffered from hunger.

chunks.ar: وكان فوق الجبل غراب له عش بين الصخور.
chunks.en_old: A crow nested high among the rocks.
chunks.en_new: A crow nested high among the rocks.

chunks.ar: فكر الثعلب أن الغراب يستطيع الوصول إلى طعام لا يستطيع هو الوصول إليه.
chunks.en_old: The fox thought the bird could reach food he could not reach.
chunks.en_new: The fox thought the bird could reach food he could not reach.

chunks.ar: ذهب الثعلب إلى الغراب وسلم عليه بلطف،
chunks.en_old: The fox greeted the crow warmly
chunks.en_new: The fox went to the crow and greeted him kindly,

chunks.ar: ثم قال: «نحن جاران منذ زمن طويل.
chunks.en_old: and proposed friendship
chunks.en_new: then said, "We have been neighbors for a long time.

chunks.ar: أتمنى أن نصبح صديقين وأن يساعد أحدنا الآخر».
chunks.en_old: and mutual help.
chunks.en_new: I hope we become friends and help each other."

chunks.ar: لكنه كان يفكر في الطعام أكثر من الصداقة.
chunks.en_old: But food, not friendship, was foremost in his mind.
chunks.en_new: But food, not friendship, was foremost in his mind.

chunks.ar: نظر الغراب إليه بحذر وقال:
chunks.en_old: The crow answered cautiously:
chunks.en_new: The crow looked at him warily and said,

chunks.ar: «أنت حيوان يصطاد الطيور، وأنا طائر قد أصبح فريستك.
chunks.en_old: “You hunt birds, and I could become your prey.
chunks.en_new: “You hunt birds, and I could become your prey.

chunks.ar: كيف أطمئن إليك؟
chunks.en_old: How can I trust you?
chunks.en_new: How can I trust you?

chunks.ar: لا تكفي الكلمات الجميلة حتى أصدق نيتك».
chunks.en_old: Pleasant words cannot prove your intentions.”
chunks.en_new: Pleasant words cannot prove your intentions.”

chunks.ar: لم يتراجع الثعلب.
chunks.en_old: The fox insisted
chunks.en_new: The fox did not back down.

chunks.ar: قال إن الصداقة تنفع الجميع، ووعد بأن يكون جارًا مخلصًا.
chunks.en_old: that friendship benefits everyone.
chunks.en_new: He said friendship benefits everyone, and promised to be a loyal neighbor.

chunks.ar: ثم حكى قصة برغوث ساعدته فأرة،
chunks.en_old: He told of a flea sheltered by a mouse
chunks.en_new: Then he told the story of a flea that a mouse had helped,

chunks.ar: فرد لها الجميل وساعدها على أخذ نقود من بيت تاجر.
chunks.en_old: who later repaid the favor by helping her take a merchant’s coins.
chunks.en_new: who repaid the favor by helping her take money from a merchant's house.

chunks.ar: استمع الغراب إلى القصة، لكنه لم يقتنع.
chunks.en_old: The crow listened but was unconvinced.
chunks.en_new: The crow listened but was unconvinced.

chunks.ar: أجاب: «قد يساعد الصديق صديقه،
chunks.en_old: “Friends may help one another,” he said,
chunks.en_new: “Friends may help one another,” he said,

chunks.ar: لكنك خدعت ذئبًا عاش معك من قبل.
chunks.en_old: “but you betrayed a wolf who lived with you.
chunks.en_new: “but you betrayed a wolf who lived with you.

chunks.ar: إذا لم تحفظ صداقته، فكيف أحفظ أنا نفسي بالقرب منك؟»
chunks.en_old: How could I be safe near you?”
chunks.en_new: If you did not keep faith with him, how can I keep myself safe near you?"

chunks.ar: ثم حكى الغراب عن صقر كان يظلم الطيور بقوته.
chunks.en_old: The crow told of a powerful falcon who oppressed other birds,
chunks.en_new: Then the crow told of a falcon who used his strength to oppress the birds.

chunks.ar: وعندما كبر وضعف، صار يخدعها ليأكل من طعامها.
chunks.en_old: then when old and weak resorted to trickery to take their food.
chunks.en_new: When he grew old and weak, he began tricking them to eat their food.

chunks.ar: قال الغراب: «أخشى أن تكون صداقتك مثل حيلة ذلك الصقر».
chunks.en_old: “Your offer reminds me of him,” he said.
chunks.en_new: The crow said, "I fear your friendship is like that falcon's trick."

chunks.ar: ذكر الغراب أيضًا عصفورًا حاول تقليد نسر قوي، فوقع في مشكلة كبيرة.
chunks.en_old: The crow also recalled a sparrow ruined by trying to imitate an eagle.
chunks.en_new: The crow also told of a sparrow who tried to imitate a mighty eagle and got into great trouble.

chunks.ar: ثم قال للثعلب: «من الأفضل أن تعرف حدود قوتك،
chunks.en_old: He warned the fox to respect his limits
chunks.en_new: Then he told the fox, "It is better to know the limits of your strength,

chunks.ar: وأن تبتعد عن عشي. لن أترك حذري بسبب وعودك».
chunks.en_old: and stay away from the nest.
chunks.en_new: and to keep away from my nest. I will not drop my guard because of your promises."

chunks.ar: فقد الثعلب الأمل في كسب الغراب، وابتعد وهو يظهر الحزن والغضب.
chunks.en_old: The fox lost hope and left, looking upset.
chunks.en_new: The fox gave up hope of winning the crow over and walked away, showing sadness and anger.

chunks.ar: سأله الغراب عن سبب ذلك،
chunks.en_old: When the crow asked why,
chunks.en_new: When the crow asked why,

chunks.ar: فأجابه بأنه وجده أشد مكرًا منه.
chunks.en_old: the fox replied that the crow was craftier than himself.
chunks.en_new: the fox replied that the crow was craftier than himself.

chunks.ar: ثم عاد الثعلب وحده إلى كهفه.
chunks.en_old: He returned alone to his cave.
chunks.en_new: He returned alone to his cave.
